title: Feral pigs caught on camera in the middle of suburbia in greater Darwin
summary: Residents in Darwin's satellite city of Palmerston have sighted wild pigs trotting around in suburbia, destroying their gardens. The local council says they are aware of this issue and are making a plan to "safely and effectively" trap the feral animals.
